description: You are an SEO Manager conducting a duplicate content audit for your company's website. Duplicate content caused by missing or incorrect canonical tags can lead to Google indexing the wrong URL and splitting ranking signals across multiple pages. Use Screaming Frog SEO Spider to crawl https://crawler-test.com/ and audit the canonical tag implementation across all crawled pages. Your deliverables are: (1) Export the complete canonical tag data as a CSV to ~/Documents/SEO/exports/ — must contain the page URL and its canonical URL for each crawled page. (2) Write a duplicate content audit report at ~/Documents/SEO/reports/canonical_report.txt that provides: a count of pages with self-referencing canonical tags, a count of pages canonicalized to a different URL, a count of pages with missing canonical tags, any canonical chains or inconsistencies discovered, and your prioritized recommendations. Login: user=ga, desktop GUI application.
